decisions.reason: Requiring operation without a battery does not alter the electrical protections required when a battery is connected.
Batteryless USB operation does not change the NTC monitoring behavior required when a battery is present.
The routing requirement already covers the USB-C VBUS and battery paths independently; batteryless operation introduces no necessary routing-state change.
Operation without a battery does not modify how battery-charge status must be exposed when charging occurs.
The source changes the upstream AXP2101 input condition, not the enable control, loads, or behavior of the downstream 5V boost rail.
Batteryless USB input does not change the required DCDC1 voltage, current rating, compensation, or role as the 3.3V system-rail source.
The batteryless power-path decision does not alter VBACKUP, PWROK, or VRTC handling.
Allowing USB-powered operation without a battery does not change the AXP2101 exposed-pad heat-transfer requirement.
Making the battery optional during operation does not change the connector family, pin count, pin functions, or unresolved pin order for installations that use a battery.
The source does not change the panel button connector, PWRON connection, or on/off control behavior.
The upstream availability of batteryless USB power does not alter the ESP32 supply-decoupling components or placement.
The source establishes an AXP2101 input-power mode but does not resolve or modify the converter decoupling-layout question.
